title: Create a Short Video Explainer for Hisa: $5000 up for grabs.
description:
About Hisa

Hisa is a mobile and web trading platform that allows users to invest in Nigerian and US stocks, as well as track their portfolios and stay updated with market news.

  • It charges a flat 1% fee on all trades, making it cost-effective for investors.

  • Users can start investing with as little as $1 and buy fractional shares of stocks, allowing for easier access to global markets.

Mission

Create a compelling short video that explains how to fund a Hisa wallet using crypto, specifically USDC or USDT. The video should also explain what stablecoins are and how you can use them to invest in US stocks via Hisa.

Scope Detail

  • Explain step-by-step how to fund a Hisa wallet using crypto (USDC or USDT).

  • Clearly define what stablecoins are.

  • Discuss why stablecoins are used as a technology to facilitate investment in US stocks through Hisa.

  • The video should be engaging and easy to understand for a broad audience.

Submission Requirements

  • Video uploaded to Instagram, Twitter, or TikTok.

  • Tag @hisanigeria and @superteamng

  • Video must be in English.

  • Target video length: 1-3 minutes.

  • The bounty is only open to Nigerians and Nigerians in the diaspora.

Judging Criteria

  • Creativity: Originality in approach or angle.

  • Educational value: Clarity and effectiveness in teaching about trading with Hisa.

  • Storytelling: Ability to hook and maintain audience attention.

  • Engagement: Potential to drive comments, shares, and replies.

  • Overall impact: The lasting impression or takeaway for viewers.

Reward Structure

  • 1st Place: $1500 USDG

  • 2nd Place: $1000 USDG

  • 3rd Place: $500 USDG

  • 4th - 10th place: vouchers worth $286 USDG each

Deadline: 30th Sept 2026
